title: Moon mass expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive and state the mass of the Moon as M = (4π²R³)/(GT²).

title: Surface gravity expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive and state the gravitational acceleration as g = (4π²R)/(T²).

title: Apply Newton's law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must equate the gravitational force to the centripetal force for the orbiting spacecraft.

title: Correct centripetal relation
description: Important Criteria: The centripetal force/acceleration must be expressed in terms of the orbital period T and radius R.

title: Orbital radius identification
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must correctly identify the orbital radius as equal to the Moon's radius R.

title: Derive g from M
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may show deriving surface g by substituting M into Newton's law of gravitation at the surface.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include a check that the final expressions have correct units for mass and acceleration.

title: Incorrect radius usage
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an orbital radius different from R (e.g., R+h) without justification.

title: Algebraic or sign error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for algebraic mistakes in solving for M or g, or incorrect sign in the force equation.
